gripOrHq.title: Project Consultants
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Ball and Chain
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

gripOrHq.title: Wall of Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Downsizing
gripOrHq.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

discardCards.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

scoreArea.title: On-Call Solo Team
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

ice.title: Fetch 4.0.1
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
